additional_info.subject: ID0420856-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5313657632001] Display Black Screen CRM:00642002252
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As per issue reported by the end customer, display is black.
Please find below attached Q feedback and knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Black screen_ FC14 flashing red - Dynamics 365
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens
Kindly perform the following steps onsite to resolve the issue:
1.Please reboot the charger.
2.You will need to change the DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers
and avoid any loop on the cable,
R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Please find the attached MLFB for your reference. Kindly validate it against the existing configuration before ordering the spare parts.
8EM5903-0AA03-8AA7 -PH6 Controlpanel DLogic Gen2 CCR Cutout AC Charging = No Credit Card Terminal = Worldline Valina OR Castles Seitatech OR Castles Neftis
8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0 -PH4 Controlpanel DLogic Gen2 CCR Contactless AC Charging = No Credit Card Terminal = No OR Contactless CCV KNB OR Contactless
As per the Spare return process, before the warranty claim, please check in the below link if the replaced part falls under the category for return.
Return spare parts Sicharge D
If yes, kindly follow the DC spare RMA process and send the defective part to the mentioned address for quality analysis before submitting warranty claim, within 30 days of repair.
